title: Get married
simplified_paragraphs: A：下个月八号我结婚，你来南湖酒店参加我的婚礼吧。
B：恭喜恭喜！没想到你那么快就要结婚了。八号是星期几？
B：星期六没问题，我休息。到时候我会准备一个大红包送给你，真为你开心！
A：谢谢，谢谢！你呢？你准备什么时候结婚？
B：我？和你分手以后，我还没有别的女朋友呢。可能有点儿不想再认识其他女孩子了。
A：你别这样……我们都分手三年了。开始新生活吧，好吗？
B：没事儿，你过得幸福就好。知道你幸福，我就很开心。
traditional_paragraphs: A：下個月八號我結婚，你來南湖酒店參加我的婚禮吧。
B：恭喜恭喜！沒想到你那麼快就要結婚了。八號是星期幾？
B：星期六沒問題，我休息。到時候我會準備一個大紅包送給你，真為你開心！
A：謝謝，謝謝！你呢？你準備什麼時候結婚？
B：我？和你分手以後，我還沒有別的女朋友呢。可能有點兒不想再認識其他女孩子了。
A：你別這樣……我們都分手三年了。開始新生活吧，好嗎？
B：沒事兒，你過得幸福就好。知道你幸福，我就很開心。
pinyin_paragraphs: A： xià gè yuè bā hào wǒ jié hūn， nǐ lái Nán Hú jiǔ diàn cān jiā wǒ de hūn lǐ ba。
B： gōng xǐ gōng xǐ！ méi xiǎng dào nǐ nà me kuài jiù yào jié hūn le。 bā hào shì xīng qī jǐ？
A： bā hào yīng gāi shì xīng qī liù。
B： xīng qī liù méi wèn tí， wǒ xiū xi。 dào shí hou wǒ huì zhǔn bèi yī gè dà hóng bāo sòng gěi nǐ， zhēn wèi nǐ kāi xīn！
A： xiè xie， xiè xie！ nǐ ne？ nǐ zhǔn bèi shén me shí hou jié hūn？
B： wǒ？ hé nǐ fēn shǒu yǐ hòu， wǒ hái méi yǒu bié de nǚ péng you ne。 kě néng yǒu diǎn r bù xiǎng zài rèn shi qí tā nǚ hái zi le。
A： nǐ bié zhè yàng …… wǒ men dōu fēn shǒu sān nián le。 kāi shǐ xīn shēng huó ba， hǎo ma？
B： méi shì r， nǐ guò de xìng fú jiù hǎo。 zhī dào nǐ xìng fú， wǒ jiù hěn kāi xīn。
A： nǐ yě yào xìng fú a！
english_paragraphs: A: I’m getting married on the 8th of next month. Come to Nanhu Hotel to attend my wedding.
B: Congratulations! I didn't expect you to get married so soon. What day of the week is the 8th?
B: No problem on Saturday, I’ll have a rest. I will prepare a big red envelope for you when the time comes. I am so happy for you!
A: Thank you, thank you! And you? When are you going to get married?
B: Me? After breaking up with you, I still don’t have another girlfriend. Maybe I don’t want to meet other girls anymore.
A: Don’t be like this... We have been separated for three years. Let's start a new life, okay?
B: It’s okay, as long as you live a happy life. Knowing that you are happy makes me happy.
A: You also want to be happy!
english_full:
A: I’m getting married on the 8th of next month. Come to Nanhu Hotel to attend my wedding.

B: Congratulations! I didn't expect you to get married so soon. What day of the week is the 8th?

A: The 8th should be Saturday.

B: No problem on Saturday, I’ll have a rest. I will prepare a big red envelope for you when the time comes. I am so happy for you!

A: Thank you, thank you! And you? When are you going to get married?

B: Me? After breaking up with you, I still don’t have another girlfriend. Maybe I don’t want to meet other girls anymore.

A: Don’t be like this... We have been separated for three years. Let's start a new life, okay?

B: It’s okay, as long as you live a happy life. Knowing that you are happy makes me happy.

A: You also want to be happy!
